$comment: Concerns raised by the designers who drew each batch (2026-09-30). Every Core design is published with designReview=pending until a human design review approves it; these icons need attention first. Keys are icon names.

notes.radian: May read as a pie chart or clock at 24 px.
notes.degree: Angle wedge with a degree ring; check the concept reads.
notes.school-bell: Close to a generic notification bell.
notes.desk-globe: Filled meridian knockout leaves thin slivers.
notes.caret-up: Caret family redefined as small triangles (chevrons no longer alias caret-*); confirm.
notes.arrow-zigzag: Reads a bit like the letter N; Filled has sharp spikes.
notes.grab: Weakest arrow-set drawing; needs a designer pass.
notes.repeat-once: The 1 is small and heavy in Filled.
notes.target: Line vs Rounded differ only in the centre dot.
notes.sari: Weakest clothing icon; the only one showing a person.
notes.fabric: May read as a paper-towel roll or receipt.
notes.uniform: May read as a chef's jacket.
notes.bracelet: May read as a ring or donut.
notes.sweater: Filled pattern busy where seams meet cuffs.
notes.crocodile: Short and squat; Rounded a bit blobby.
notes.hamster: May read as bear or mouse at 16 px.
notes.squirrel: Head and ear a little crude.
notes.lion: Rounded mane reads a little like a flower.
notes.fish-bowl: Filled water-line knockout gives the rim a band look.
notes.goat: Line horns and ears spiky and busy.
notes.file-pdf: Weakly distinguished from file-document and file-text (no letters).
notes.file-presentation: Pie chart may look like a clock at 16 px.
notes.dossier: Small risk of reading as a briefcase.
notes.intercom: May read as a speaker box.
notes.follow: Same meaning as the generated user-plus variant.
notes.unfollow: Same meaning as the generated user-minus variant.
notes.followers: Looks like a two-person users icon.
notes.home-screen: May read as a remote control or calculator.
notes.keyboard-shortcut: Reads as a key, less as a shortcut.
notes.radio-button: Includes label lines so Line and Rounded differ.
notes.form: Readable but not a strong symbol.
notes.deploy: Arrow into a server; concept check.
notes.bomb-disposal: Disposal only hinted at by the cut fuse.
notes.bluetooth: Uses the standard Bluetooth rune (trademarked mark of the Bluetooth SIG); confirm acceptable under the no-logos rule.
notes.usb: Uses the USB trident (trademarked mark of USB-IF); confirm acceptable; busy at 16 px.
notes.earbuds: Looks a bit like two lollipops.
notes.hard-drive: Disc in a case; compromise drawing.
notes.drone: Redrawn by the integrator (was identical to network-topology); review.
notes.pancakes: Looks a little like a beehive or jar.
notes.pepper-shaker: Pepper mill; may pass for a lamp or chess piece.
notes.xylophone: May read as a bar chart.
notes.tambourine: May read as a bead ring.
notes.microphone-stand: Tripod may look like a stick figure.
notes.violin: May be mistaken for a cello.
notes.intestines: Looks like a maze at 16 px.
notes.elbow: May look like a pipe fitting.
notes.knee: May look like a pipe fitting.
notes.muscle-fiber: May read as a rugby ball.
notes.jaw: Head in profile with jawline marked.
notes.sign-language: Single hand with motion arcs; close to hand-wave.
notes.sundial: May read as a birdbath or satellite dish.
notes.sculpture: Filled may read as a pawn or person.
notes.origami: Paper boat; crane was not recognisable.
notes.polygon: Line shows nodes, Filled a plain polygon.
notes.bandage: May read as a tape roll.
notes.virus-shield: Virus may look like a ship's wheel at 16 px.
notes.quarantine: Virus may look like a ship's wheel at 16 px.
notes.nutrition: May read as a pie chart.
notes.moon-phases: New moon dotted ring looks like a spinner in Line.
notes.space-station: May read as a network diagram.
notes.hand-coins: Coin stack may read as a database.
notes.harvest: Sheaf of grain; weak at 24 px.
notes.stadium: May look like a hockey puck at 16–24 px.
notes.mall: Bag may read as a padlock at 16 px.
notes.temple: Hindu gopuram; needs review by someone who knows the tradition.
notes.khanda: Simplified for 24 px; needs review by someone from the tradition.
notes.om: Simplified for 24 px; needs review by someone from the tradition.
notes.hamsa: Filled relies on knocked-out finger lines.
notes.party-face: Rounded hat may look like a play triangle.
notes.rope: Weakest tools icon; may read as a snail.
notes.roller-coaster: Faceted Line loop is only okay.
notes.goal-net: Dense at 24 px; may read as a fence.
notes.hockey: Puck drawn as a small bar.
notes.hierarchy: Pyramid may be confused with buildings/pyramid.
notes.canoe: May read as an eye with a spoon.
